headline: The AI that stands beside your family at every insurance moment.
subhead: Kavach remembers your family's cover and acts when it matters: when life changes, at the hospital desk, and when a claim goes wrong.
previewCaption: What Kavach tells the family at the hospital desk

claim.title: When a claim goes wrong
claim.body: Send the settlement letter. Kavach checks every deduction against your policy and drafts the appeal.

whatsapp.title: No app? Same answer on WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Send a photo of the estimate or a Hindi voice note. Kavach replies with a voice note and a card.
whatsapp.qrAlt: QR code that opens WhatsApp with the message to join Kavach’s test number
whatsapp.notConfigured: The WhatsApp test number isn’t set up yet.
whatsapp.step1: Scan the code with your phone camera. WhatsApp opens with a join message.
whatsapp.step2: Send that message to join Kavach’s test number.
whatsapp.step3: Send RAHUL to get the family alert on your phone, then send a photo of an estimate or a voice note.
whatsapp.note: This uses a WhatsApp test number. Membership lasts 3 days; scan again after that.

trust.title: Every number shows its working
trust.body: Rupee amounts come from tested rules, never from a guess. Tap “Why these numbers?” to see the rule and the clause behind each one.

footer.disclaimer: Guidance, not a policy recommendation. Confirm with your insurer or the TPA desk.

IN.lead: Kavach remembers every policy in the house and tells you what to do when life changes, at the hospital desk, and when a claim comes back short. In Hindi or English. Every rupee comes from written policy terms, with the page number.
IN.tryHospitalSub: Sample estimate, Hindi or English, under a minute. No sign-in.
IN.momentsIntro: Kavach learns the household once, in about two minutes. Then it acts at the three moments where Indian families lose money.
IN.otherSub: Ah Kow’s angioplasty: a Class B1 Shield plan offered Class A, in Mandarin.

family.title: The sample family Kavach already knows
family.caption: Five people, four policies, one picture. Kavach learnt them once, in about two minutes.

relations.mother: Kamala, 58 · opens Kavach at the desk

story.step1Body: In Hindi, on her own phone. Kavach already knows Suresh’s two policies.
story.step2Title: She shows the estimate to the camera
story.step2Body: Kavach reads the room tariff: deluxe {quoted} a day, standard {lower}.
story.step3Body: Only room-priced charges are cut in the pricier room. Kavach says which card to give first, and what to ask the desk.

decision.patient: Suresh, 62 · planned angioplasty · two policies in the family
decision.why: Suresh’s policy pays a room up to a limit. Above it, the insurer also cuts the surgeon, theatre and other room-priced charges in the same proportion.
decision.script: “Please book the standard room for my father, at {amount} a day or less.”
decision.firstCard: Give the parents’ policy card first; the other policy covers what is left.

moments.change: “Joining a startup on 1 Dec.” Kavach sees that your parents’ cover ends on 30 Nov, drafts the letter to keep it, and reminds you on WhatsApp.
moments.hospital: Voice and camera, in Hindi. Show the estimate and Kavach says which policy card to give and which room to ask for.

IN.whatsappBody: Send a photo of the estimate or a Hindi voice note. Kavach replies with a voice note and a card.

chat.ask: The desk is offering the deluxe room at {quoted} a day. Can we take it?
chat.reply: Ask for the standard room at {lower} a day. In the deluxe room the policy also cuts the surgeon and theatre charges.

family.title: The sample family Kavach already knows
family.caption: Five people, MediShield Life and a Shield plan, one picture. Kavach learnt them once, in about two minutes.

story.step1Title: The family taps At the hospital
story.step1Body: In Mandarin, on their own phone. Kavach already knows Ah Kow’s MediShield Life and his Shield plan.
story.step2Title: They show the estimate to the camera
story.step2Body: Kavach reads the ward charges: Class A {quoted} a day, Class B1 {lower}.
story.step3Body: His Shield plan is bought for Class B1. In Class A it pays only part of the bill. Kavach says which card to give first, and what to ask the desk.

decision.patient: Ah Kow, 68 · planned angioplasty · Shield plan bought for Class B1
decision.why: Ah Kow’s Shield plan is bought for a Class B1 ward. In a Class A ward the plan pays only part of the bill, so the family pays much more for the same treatment.
decision.script: “Please admit my father to a Class B1 ward.”
decision.firstCard: Give the Shield plan card first; MediShield Life is part of it.

moments.change: “Changing jobs next month.” Kavach checks which cover ends with the job, what the family’s Shield plans still pay, and reminds you on WhatsApp.
moments.hospital: Voice and camera, in Mandarin or Malay. Show the estimate and Kavach says which card to give and which ward to ask for.
moments.claimStat: Every deduction checked against the plan

SG.whatsappBody: Send a photo of the estimate or a voice note in Mandarin or Malay. Kavach replies with a voice note and a card.

chat.ask: The hospital is offering a Class A ward at {quoted} a day. Should we take it?
chat.reply: Ask for the Class B1 ward at {lower} a day. In Class A his Shield plan pays only part of the bill.
